The citation is inaccurate because the ground truth does not support that this particular assertion originates from that paper.

The citation is fabricated because the ground truth does not support that this specific claim is made by Farhan in 2025.

However, the section text implies that Yasin et al. (2025) directly reported this issue, which is not supported by the ground truth—it only lists the gap and its supporting evidence without stating that Yasin et al. explicitly made the claim.
